text.body: oṃ saha nāvastu | saha nau bhunaktu | saha vīryaṃ karavāvahai | tejasvi nāvadhītamastu mā vidviṣāvahe | oṃ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ śāntiḥ || purastādbrahmaṇastasya viṣṇoradbhutakarmaṇaḥ | rahasyaṃ brahmavidyāyā dhṛtāgniṃ saṃpracakṣate || omityekākṣaraṃ brahma yaduktaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ | śarīraṃ tasya vakṣyāmi sthānakālatrayaṃ tathā || tatra devāstrayaḥ proktā lokā vedāstrayo'gnayaḥ | tisro mātrārdhamātrā ca pratyakṣasya śivasya tat || ṛgvedo gārhapatyaṃ ca pṛthivī brahma eva ca | akārasya śarīraṃ tu vyākhyātaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || yajurvedo'ntarikṣaṃ ca dakṣiṇāgnistathaiva ca | viṣṇuśca bhagavān deva ukāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ || sāmavedastathā dyauścāhavanīyastathaiva ca | īśvaraḥ paramo devo makāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ || sūryamaṇḍalamābhāti hyakāraścandramadhyagaḥ | ukāraścandrasaṃkāśastasya madhye vyavasthitaḥ | makāraścāgnisaṃkāśo vidhūmo vidyutopamaḥ | tisro mātrāstathā jñeyāḥ somasūryāgnitejasaḥ || śikhā ca dīpasaṃkāśā yaminnu parivartate | ardhamātrā tathā jñeyā praṇavasyopari sthitā || padmasūtranibhā sūkṣmā śikhābhā dṛśyate parā | nāsādisūryasaṃkāśā sūryaṃ hitvā tathāparam | dvisaptatisahasrāṇi nāḍibhistvā tu mūrdhani | varadaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaiva tiṣṭhati || kāṃsyaghaṇṭāninādaḥ syādyadā lipyati śāntaye| oṅkārastu tathā yojyaḥ śrutaye sarvamicchati || yasmin sa līyate śabdastatparaṃ brahma gīyate | so'mṛtatvāya kalpate so'mṛtatvāya kalpate || iti || iti praṇavopaniṣatsamāptā
